prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all five initial tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Evidence is still thin for all individual kinds of changes (adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, home new_flow, sign_in hint) as each has only been tested once so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +4.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Clarification: Add an explicit hint and explanatory note to the sign-in screen warning users about signing into the correct account. (why: The top support theme with 8 emails involved missing or reset pets due to re-signing into wrong or different accounts.)
1: [home, wait_info] Estimated Wait Time Indicator: Enable time estimates and readiness notifications on the waiting screen while the pet is generated. (why: The home waiting step has the longest mean wait duration (2336s), causing drop-offs before users complete setup.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Guide Screen: Add a dedicated controls screen right after home intro explaining how to move, hide, and interact with the pet. (why: Multiple support emails noted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Live Preview Flow: Insert a preview sub-flow screen before photo uploading so users see sample results before committing photos. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pets failing or looking wrong, causing user friction during the adoption step.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Path Selection Layout: Switch choose_path layout to spotlight to give equal visual weight and focus to both standard and custom paths. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite median 8s, indicating some users stall selecting a path.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Arrival Quick Reference: Update home_intro text to clearly state that the pet is now visible on the screen and give quick tips. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop / app not opening, and 3 emails asked how to interact.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Deferred Sign In: Move sign-in to take place after pet selection and waiting, right before onboarding finishes. (why: Asking users to sign in early (step 2) creates drop-off (72.9%) before users experience pet customization.)
7: [home, notification] Background Wait Notification Alert: Add desktop readiness notification enabling and background processing badge on the waiting screen. (why: The average waiting step time is over 38 minutes (2336s), leading to user drop-offs if they close the app.)

scores.note: Top support theme (8 emails), but past sign_in hint test produced a negative lift (-0.9%).
Funnel highlights extreme mean wait time (2336s); wait time indicator reduces uncertainty drop-offs.
Adding a new screen to finish step previously reduced conversion (-3.0%) despite support complaints.
Adoption step has lowest completion (60.9%) and support issues, though new screens add friction.
Choose_path redesign showed strongest past historical lift (+4.2%), addressing mean completion time outlier.
Targeted text update addresses 6 support emails at high cost-efficiency without adding full screen friction.
Deferring early sign-in barrier (72.9% drop) can increase early onboarding progression significantly.
Directly targets the 38+ minute mean waiting drop-off by keeping users engaged asynchronously.
